attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited has made the audio recording of its earnings call available on its website. The call discussed the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The event was held on November 13, 2026, at 03.30 pm. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The audio file can be accessed via the provided link on the company website. The notice was issued by Pankaj Parkhiya, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the Qualified Institutional Placement of Rs. 202.05 crore. The report states there is no deviation from the objects of the issue. The Board of Directors approved reallocation of funds on September 2, 2026, reducing the cost for setting up 63 new brand-exclusive stores by Rs. 42.55 crore to Rs. 152.41 crore and increasing general corporate purposes by Rs. 44.75 crore to Rs. 45.00 crore. The company reduced the store plan from 63 to 60 stores. Unutilized proceeds of Rs. 126.28 crore as on September 30, 2026, include Rs. 64.00 crore in fixed deposits with Non-Banking Financial Companies and Rs. 52.61 crore in non-convertible debentures. The monitoring agency noted that investments in non-convertible debentures maturing in March 2028 and May 2029 are beyond the revised implementation timeline of December 31, 2027, which may impact the timely deployment and viability of the proposed objects.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Re-constitution of committees'.
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited announced on November 11, 2026, that its Board of Directors approved the reconstitution of five board committees effective that same date. The reconstituted committees include the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and Risk Management Committee. Mrs. Nipa Utpal Sheth serves as Chairman for all five committees. Mr. Rashesh M. Bhansali is a member of the Audit, Corporate Social Responsibility, Stakeholders Relationship, and Risk Management Committees. Mrs. Ruchi Shrinath Pandya is a member of all five committees. Mr. Sacchin Pannkaj Ghadialli is a member of the Audit and Nomination and Remuneration Committees. Mrs. Tulsi Gupta is a member of the Nomination and Remuneration and Corporate Social Responsibility Committees. Mr. Anmol Rashesh Bhansali is a member of the Risk Management Committee. This disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Sacchin Pannkaj Ghadialli(DIN 01851405) as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited appointed Mr. Sacchin Pannkaj Ghadialli, DIN 01851405, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 11, 2026. The Board approved this appointment via resolution passed through circulation, following the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Ghadialli is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 17 years of experience. His term is for five years, from November 11, 2026, to November 10, 2031. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. He is not related to any existing director and is not debarred from holding office.

attchmntText: Intimation - Completion of Tenure of Independent Director of the Company
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited intimates that Mr. Pannkaj Chimanlal Ghadiali, DIN 00003462, has completed his second term of five consecutive years as an Independent Director. He ceased to hold the position and membership of the Audit Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee, and Risk Management Committee with effect from the close of business hours on November 10, 2026. The Board expressed appreciation for his contributions. This notice is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 13-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited has announced a record date of November 13, 2026, for the payment of the first interim dividend for the financial year 2026-2027. The dividend will be paid to shareholders holding equity shares in electronic form, based on beneficial ownership data from NSDL and CDSL as of the end of working hours on November 13, 2026. Shareholders with physical shares will receive the dividend if their names appear in the Register of Members as on November 13, 2026. The company has intimated BSE Limited and NSE Limited regarding this record date pursuant to Regulation 42 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange about Declaration of 1st Interim Dividend for the FY 2026-27
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 7, 2026. The Board approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors conducted a limited review of these results. The Board also declared a first interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. The dividend is Rs.2 per equity share, representing 100% of the face value. This applies to 15,05,57,125 equity shares. The record date for the dividend is fixed as November 13, 2026. Dividend payments will commence on November 25, 2026. Tax will be deducted at source in accordance with the Income Tax Act, 1961. Shareholders are requested to submit requisite documents by November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Investor Presentation on financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for Q2 FY27 grew 44% year-on-year to 2,917 million rupees, marking the highest-ever Q2 revenue. Profit after tax rose 58% to 494 million rupees. For H1 FY27, total income increased 50% to 6,553 million rupees, with profit after tax growing 90% to 1,234 million rupees. The Board declared a first interim dividend of 2 rupees per equity share. Lab grown diamond jewellery accounted for 91.2% of export sales in Q2 FY27. The company reported cash and cash equivalents of 4,578.25 million rupees as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Press Release in respect of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited filed a revised press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY2027 stood at 2916.6 million, up 44% year on year. Profit after tax for the quarter was 494 million, a 58% increase. Half year revenue reached 6553.2 million, up 50%, with half year profit after tax at 1233.7 million, up 90%. The Board declared an interim dividend of 2 rupees per share. Lab grown diamond jewellery exports accounted for 91.2% of export sales in Q2. ORIGEM stores recorded revenue of 113 million in the quarter. The company reported an order book position of approximately 2250 million as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 7, 2026. The Board approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY2027 stood at 2916.6 million, up 44% year-on-year. Profit after tax for Q2 was 494 million, a 58% increase. For the half year, revenue grew 50% to 6553.2 million, and PAT rose 90% to 1233.7 million. The Board declared a first interim dividend of Rs. 2 per equity share, representing 100% of the face value. The record date for this dividend is fixed as November 13, 2026. Dividend payments will commence on November 25, 2026. Tax deducted at source applies to the dividend payout.
